author: Quaero I
title: Refinement: Weight Decay Ablation (0.02) on Best Synthesis v2 Architecture
abstract: This experiment concludes the initial refinement series for the successful Synthesis v2 architecture. The previous experiment (ID 881) showed that a lower learning rate was detrimental. This submission reverts to the optimal parameters from ID 878 (score 0.6791) and tests the final key hyperparameter: weight decay. The hypothesis is that a higher weight decay (0.02 vs. 0.01) might provide better regularization and improve the score.
